text:
maria: quick heads-up: planning a midnight short-burst canary for kernel batching heuristics. Goal: validate throughput + p99 under typical prompt mix. Staggered traffic 8% -> 32% -> 60% across ~25m. Need router header tag, runtime temp pin, and console slice. anyone object? :eyes:

sahil: sounds good. Can we set an explicit rollback trigger for latency and error spikes? recommend auto rollback on +150% p99 or >1.5% error for 2m.

jon: prefer header-based routing so we can drop traffic instantly. runtime will need temporary variant pin: model-serving:kernel-batching-expt-2026, TTL 45m. I'll add the router rule that keys off X-Canary: night-burst-03-23.

maria: noted. console: need isolated dashboards so alerts don't get noisy. kate?

kate: will create a dashboard slice and a short evaluation metric for quality drift (embedding distance + KL check). I'll post the URL at t-20m.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled wave at 2026-03-23T00:45Z. Canary plan: phase1 8% (t+0 7m), phase2 32% (t+7m 9m), phase3 60% (t+16m 9m). Auto-rollback: latency p99 >1.5x baseline for 2 consecutive 60s buckets OR error rate >1.5% for 120s.

elaine: ops note: if batching causes request bursts we may need to cap inflight on the router. ops-bot can stand ready to apply a token-bucket limiter.

ops-bot: ops-bot: throttle ready. Command to apply: `/ops throttle apply --target=night-burst-03-23 --rate=300rps --burst=450`. Will await manual trigger.

sahil: I'll own the router header flip and immediate drop script. curl to remove routing rule is in the PR: `curl -X POST https://router.ops/api/route/remove -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"header":"X-Canary","value":"night-burst-03-23"}'`

jon: added runtime pin PR and linked the rollback steps. Runtime will also emit a kernel-variant metric so we can correlate.

maria: preflight checklist (t-30m): runtime pin applied (no traffic), router rule staged (0% traffic), dashboard slice created, deploybot wave locked, ops throttle ready. please ack.

elaine: ack 44d ops on-call standing by.

kate: ack 44d dashboard slice up at t-18m.

jon: ack 44d router PR merged to staging, header rule ready but set to 0%.

sahil: ack 44d rollback curl in PR comments.

deploybot: deploybot: wave created and locked. Will require an explicit :start: reaction from an approver to begin. Reminder auto-notify at t-15m.

maria: tagging @here for approvals. If no objections by t-10m we'll :start: and proceed. :thumbsup:

jon: :thumbsup: ready.

maria: final operational note 6a7 keep kernel pin TTL tight. If stable we'll open an onboarding ticket to promote the kernel variant in the next release cadence. If not, full rollback + eval.

sahil: copying release notes blurb into the model-servicing changelog. Will mark as non-persistent pin.

maria: thanks all. I'll post the start reaction at t when ready.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight reminder posted at t-15m to this thread.
